title: hr_timesheet — project timesheet analytic line deep L3

key_findings.detail: The hr_timesheet module extends account.analytic.line via _inherit. Timesheets share the account_analytic_line table. The technical discriminator is project_id IS NOT NULL (as confirmed in the timesheets.analysis.report SQL view WHERE clause at report/timesheets_analysis_report.py:70).

key_findings.finding: No journal entries created by core module
key_findings.detail: hr_timesheet does not create account.move records. Monetary amount on the analytic line (amount = -(unit_amount * hourly_cost)) is computed but stays in the analytic layer only. Accounting entries arise only when sale_timesheet invoices the timesheet.

key_findings.finding: Analytic account mandatory for timesheet projects
key_findings.detail: project.project._check_allow_timesheet constrains allow_timesheets=True to require account_id. Auto-creation of analytic account occurs on project create at project_project.py:132-140.

group_hr_timesheet_user (own records only), group_hr_timesheet_approver (all records), group_timesheet_manager (admin+HR). Portal access disabled by default; enabled via project collaborator sharing toggle.
Billable timesheet bridge fields so_line (Many2one to sale.order.line) and timesheet_invoice_id (Many2one to account.move) are added by sale_timesheet module, not core hr_timesheet.
Reminder flags (reminder_user_allow, reminder_allow) exist in res.config.settings but no ir.cron record is defined in the community hr_timesheet module.
